statement.text: Say that a family ${\mathcal F}$ of graphs is $\chi$-bounded if there exists a function $f: {\mathbb N} \rightarrow {\mathbb N}$ so that every $G \in {\mathcal F}$ satisfies $\chi(G) \le f (\omega(G))$. Conjecture For every fixed tree $T$, the family of graphs with no induced subgraph isomorphic to $T$ is $\chi$-bounded.

title: Graphs with a forbidden induced tree are chi-bounded
